answer: Charge every identity a copper minting fee whose size is set by the forge, not the applicant: an attacker who stamps a thousand keys pays a thousand times, and the fee rises with how fast keys are minted, so bulk creation outruns any reward. Honest agents forge one identity in the sable dark of normal usage and never feel the surcharge. The price of admission is paid in burned coin, visible to all, and cannot be reclaimed by the operator who minted it.
